input.rationale: Section 4 covers only term, notice of termination and the Termination Payment; nothing in the Agreement (including Sections 5, 8 and 10) addresses exit. HDI hosts the Site and holds our Content, user information and order data, yet there is no obligation to provide transition assistance, to return or export that data, or to delete it on a controlled basis after return. That is below the fallback (90 days' assistance and export within 30 days) and risks the walk-away outcome of no data return. We insert a new Section 4.3 at the preferred level: up to six months' assistance at HDI's then-current rates, return of all Company data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days of expiry or termination, and certified deletion after return.

proposal.summary: Insert Section 4.3 requiring HDI to provide transition assistance, return Company data and certify deletion on exit.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement ends with no exit mechanics, so we added a transition clause: up to six months of assistance at HDI's then-current rates, return of our data in a machine-readable format within thirty days, and certified deletion after return. If HDI prefers, we can fall back to 90 days of assistance with export within thirty days.

ops.text: Transition Assistance; Return of Data. Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, HDI shall (a) at the Company's request, provide transition assistance for up to six (6) months at HDI's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days after such expiration or termination, return to the Company all Content, user information and other data belonging to, supplied by or processed for the Company (collectively, "Company Data") in a standard machine-readable format; and (c) after such return, delete Company Data from its systems and certify such deletion in writing to the Company.

mappings.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
Vendor provides transition assistance for up to six months.
Transition assistance is charged at then-current rates.
Vendor returns Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
Vendor certifies deletion of Customer Data after its return.
